features.matchText: The Employer makes a “safe harbor” matching contribution equal to 100% of each participant’s compensation, up to a maximum of 5% of compensation. Contr
features.vestingText: Participants become vested in the Employer “safe harbor” matching contributions immediately.
features.afterTaxText: Participants may also elect to make pre-tax or after-tax contributions.
features.eligibilityText: Under the provisions of the Plan, employees are eligible to make elective deferrals upon hire after turning 21 years old, and eligible to receive employer contributions after completing three consecutive months of service.
features.autoEnrollText: Participants are automatically enrolled at 5% of compensation.
